basis: Approved session plan section 8, session capture-contract.json, and TEMP regroup-adapter-preflight.md; not a new normative repository API.

backend.discovery: Separate explicit operator command requiring permitDiscovery; never part of constructor, describe defaults, HTTP startup or action/property handlers.
nativeFormats: Progressive RGB32 with bounded signed stride
Progressive even-width YUY2 with evidenced BT.601 limited-range colorimetry
Progressive even-dimension positive-stride NV12 with evidenced BT.601 limited-range colorimetry
backend.sampleTime: Exact signed decimal IMFSample presentation time/duration in 100 ns; not exposure or UTC.
backend.identity: SHA-256 of exact selected Windows instance/container evidence; serial and transport remain unknown.
backend.workerConcurrency: One native operation or acquisition session per CaptureBackend instance.
backend.permission: Trusted local authorizeOpen callback, denied by default. configuredCapturePermission is a finite allowlist, not a grant/lease protocol.
backend.linuxQualification: Compilation, SDK runtime and hardware unverified; actual V4L2 and Aravis source implemented

canonical.validation: Both directions: integrity-checked packaged payloads.schema.json plus public encodeElement with the full source-pinned XML registry.
canonical.profilePolicy: One operator-configured, persisted, adapter-owned media profile; no auto-profiles from mutually exclusive native modes.
canonical.snapshotPolicy: Actual stable HTTP JPEG property Form. A configured URI can exist while GET reports unavailable. Neither lookup nor GET acquires a frame.
canonical.abstractModels: Application supplies typed createSemanticAdapterTd using the model owner's deriveAdapterTd API. One abstract composite type; no native SOAP/profile TM inheritance.

protocol.input: Bounded UTF-8 tab-separated command lines, LF terminated, at most 32768 bytes before LF. Selectors are UTF-8 hex in the private command pipe, not process arguments.
protocol.outputHeader: 8 bytes: little-endian uint32 JSON length and little-endian uint32 binary length.
protocol.outputBody: UTF-8 JSON metadata followed immediately by raw owned frame bytes; binary data is never base64 JSON.

commands.describe: backend, selectorHex, expectedIdentityHash, permit-native-read or permit-software-read
commands.open: backend, selectorHex, expectedIdentityHash, evidenceDigest, modeId, output, maxWidth, maxHeight, maxNativeBytes, maxFrameBytes, nativeReadMs, durationMs, permit-acquisition
commands.next: No arguments; one outstanding caller request.
commands.close: No arguments; graceful flush/shutdown receipt then observed process exit.
commands.discover: permit-discovery; private output only in an explicit operator command.

protocol.forcedClose: Unknown acquisition/resource state; never a successful stop assertion.

limits.scope: Adapter-owned logical queues, cache and in-flight writes are bounded. SDK/OS pools and caller-retained copies are not a claimed hard process-memory cap.

http.binding: node-wot 0.9.2 HttpServer with bounded authorization/error middleware dispatching through real ExposedThing handlers
http.snapshotSerialization: Finite ReadableStream from the exact polyfill resolved by @node-wot/core.
